graph_profile.critical_completion: A critical requirement has at least one incoming goal requires edge and a complete requirement→feature→task→test→gate path.

immutability: Corpus hash and this evaluation-plan hash are embedded in the frozen v0.05 release contract.

metrics.critical_traceability_coverage_rate: critical requirements with a complete ordered traceability path / critical requirements in accepted valid + impact graphs
metrics.diagnostic_code_precision: emitted error diagnostics whose code is preregistered for that invalid case / all emitted error diagnostics in invalid cases
metrics.impact_analysis_exact_match_rate: impact cases whose upstream and downstream sets exactly match preregistration / impact cases
metrics.invalid_graph_detection_rate: invalid cases containing every preregistered expected code / invalid cases
metrics.valid_graph_acceptance_rate: valid + impact graphs with zero error diagnostics / valid + impact graphs

target_policy: All synthetic frozen metrics target 1.0 and valid false-positive count targets 0. Promotion remains experimental without independent real-project evidence.
